issues.message: “maxconn” is outside any section. Every directive must go inside global, defaults, frontend, backend…
There is no global section (it is optional, but it is usually used for logging, user and limits).
frontend “web”: missing “timeout client” (neither here nor in defaults).
This TLS bind does not declare “alpn h2,http/1.1”: clients will not be able to use HTTP/2.
The ACL “is_admin” is not defined in this section.
The ACL “missing_acl” is not defined in this section.
frontend “sinbind” has no bind line: it does not listen on any port.
frontend “sinbind”: missing “timeout client” (neither here nor in defaults).
backend “api”: missing “timeout server” (neither here nor in defaults).
“bind” is not valid in a backend section.
The server “a1” uses TLS without verifying the certificate.
backend “tcpbe”: missing “timeout server” (neither here nor in defaults).
frontend “mezcla”: missing “timeout client” (neither here nor in defaults).
An http-mode frontend cannot send traffic to the backend “tcpbe”, which is in tcp mode.
listen “stats”: missing “timeout client” (neither here nor in defaults).
listen “stats”: missing “timeout server” (neither here nor in defaults).
The statistics page password looks like a placeholder. Change it.
“fronted” at the start of a line is not a known section. Is it misspelled?

explanations.text: **HTTP mode** (layer 7): HAProxy parses requests, headers and paths, and can apply rules to them.
Maximum time to establish the TCP connection to a server: **5 s**
Listens on all interfaces, port `443` · **TLS / HTTPS** · certificate `/etc/haproxy/certs/site.pem`
Defines the condition `is_api`: the path starts with `/api` or `/v2` (case-insensitive)

explanations.args: redirect scheme https code 301 unless { ssl_fc }
explanations.text: Request: Redirects to **HTTPS** (301 permanent) — unless “the incoming connection is TLS”
Request: **Denies** the request (429) — if “the client's request rate (counter 0) is greater than **20**”
Sends to the backend **api** — if `is_api` and **not** `is_admin` or `missing_acl`
Default backend: **nope** — receives everything that matches no `use_backend` rule
Default backend: **api** — receives everything that matches no `use_backend` rule
Load balancing: picks the server with the **fewest active connections** (ideal for long sessions)
Listens on all interfaces, port `9000`

explanations.args: a1 10.0.0.1:443 ssl verify none check inter 2s fall 3 rise 2 backup
explanations.text: Server **a1** at `10.0.0.1:443` · **TLS** connection to the server · ⚠ certificate not verified · active health checks · check every **2 s** · marked down after **3** failures · healthy again after **2** successful checks · **backup**: only receives traffic if the others go down
Generates **5** servers `web1`…`web5` from `web.local:8080` · active health checks
**TCP mode** (layer 4): forwards the bytes as they are, without inspecting HTTP.
Listens on all interfaces, port `8080`
Default backend: **tcpbe** — receives everything that matches no `use_backend` rule
Listens on all interfaces, port `8404`
Enables the **statistics web page**
Protected with the user **admin** and a password
Directive that haro does not recognize (it may be valid in your version; check the documentation).
